title: Tesserae renderer manifest
description: Shape of renderer.json. Declares the wire-side of a publish target: how to transform the composition PNG, what to publish, where, and whether to retain.

tesserae_compat.description: Major version range this renderer works against (e.g. '1.x'). The loader rejects mismatches.

orientation.description: How transform() orients its output relative to the canonical composition PNG.

topic_pattern.description: MQTT topic the artifact is published to. '{device}' is substituted from the 'device' field at load time.

device.description: Device-type prefix this renderer targets (e.g. 'pi', 'esp32'). Must match the id of a device plugin that declares this renderer.

retain.description: Whether the broker should retain the publish so a freshly-woken subscriber sees it on first wake.
